headline: President Bush amended an earlier order that set up a federal task force on the economy of California's Central San Joaquin Valley.
what_it_does: This order changes Executive Order 13173, which created a group of federal agencies to work on economic development in the Central San Joaquin Valley in California. No summary was provided, so the specific changes it makes to that task force are not clear from the title alone.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies serving on the San Joaquin Valley task force
who_it_affects.how: The rules for how their task force is set up or run are changed in ways the title does not spell out.

when_it_takes_effect: 2004-10-20 (date signed; exact effective date not stated)
